gloss: to run all the way; to finish running

definitions.gloss: to run all the way (to the end); to finish running a distance
definitions.explanation: To run from start to finish without stopping, completing the entire intended distance. Emphasizes seeing the run through to its end rather than the speed or quality of running.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{走|はし}り{切|き}った。
examples.english: I ran all the way to the goal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{走|はし}り{切|き}る⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I don't have the confidence to run the whole distance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}く→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、なん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{四十二|よんじゅうに}⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{走|はし}り{切|き}ること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: My legs started to hurt partway, but I somehow managed to run the whole 42 kilometers.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (to run) + ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to finish completely, used as a suffix). The 〜⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ ending adds the meaning of doing something all the way through to completion.

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive in basic use (⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{走|はし}り{切|き}る), but can take a distance as the object marked with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ ({四十二|よんじゅうに}⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{走|はし}り{切|き}る).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{走|はし}り{切|き}る: run all the way to the goal
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{走|はし}り{切|き}る: run to the very end
- フルマラソン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{走|はし}り{切|き}る: complete a full marathon

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{走|はし}り→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧: run all the way through — emphasizes determination and pushing past difficulty
- ⟦{完走|かんそう}する→完走する：15643_kansousuru⟧: complete a race — formal, used for organized events
